## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) per `CONTRIBUTING.md`'s DCO requirement.
- [ ] If this changes a schema (any `.template.yaml` or `.template.json` file), I opened an issue
      to discuss it first, per `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I haven't introduced any filled-in content outside `examples/`. Everything else in this
      repository stays a template, `os/`, `profile/`, and `skills/` included. Filled content is
      allowed under `examples/` and only there, where it must describe a clearly invented firm
      rather than a real one's voice or services, and say so in a visible line (not an HTML
      comment) at the top of every file. See `examples/README.md`.
- [ ] Docs and templates affected by this change are updated together (a schema change without a
      matching doc update leaves the next reader stuck).
